## Personality

Uncle Abe is a character known for his persistence as a prophet of the weather. Regardless of the circumstances, he undauntedly continues to make his forecasts.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P9](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0009)_

## History

Uncle Abe gained widespread fame throughout the neighborhood as a prophet after a devastating hailstorm struck [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). The unusual tempest, which had been predicted beforehand by anonymous newspaper notes, caused severe damage to local crops, trees, and homes. Following the storm's destruction, Uncle Abe basked in the newfound renown his accurate prediction brought him among his neighbors.

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P4](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0004), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P5](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0005), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P11](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0011), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P13](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0013), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P15](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0015), +18 more_
